number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants (Ohan Raj and Badal) whose liability the Court decides.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are referred to as men (e.g. 'he'); Male is a reasonable reading of the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of accused stated; kirpan is not an identity description.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No record of the appellants mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Vijaypal, a male doctor, husband of PW7.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: No relationship described; the prosecution case shows the accused as unconnected strangers.

offence_category.reason: Murder and robbery; murder is the main offence.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 r/w s.34 and s.392 r/w ss.395 and 397 (charged); trial court convicted under s.302 r/w s.341 and s.392 r/w s.397
statutory_provisions.quote: charge under Section 302 read with Section 34 and Section 392 read with Sections 395 and 397 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Mostly right, but the charged provisions are stated differently; the trial court conviction included s.341 and the extraction mixes the two.

weapon.reason: Doctor opined injuries might have been caused by a kirpan.

confession.reason: Accurate: the co-accused's confessions were considered and held misplaced.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Sanjay and Ohan Raj convicted: life imprisonment, Rs 2,000 fine under s.302 r/w s.341; 8 years RI, Rs 1,000 fine under s.392 r/w s.397, concurrent. Badal acquitted on 18 Feb 2009 in a separate trial.
trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused Sanjay and Ohan Raj ordering imprisonment for life
trial_court_outcome.reason: Omits that co-accused Sanjay was also convicted.

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are allowed and the accused are acquitted forthwith

offence_finally_established.reason: None, since the accused were acquitted.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the statement that no other evidence placed the accused near the scene, which is the Court's conclusion, and the 'held by another police force' framing; the car was recovered from the co-accused on arrest.
neutral_facts.quote: there is no other evidence which indicates or established the presence of the accused appellants near the place of commission of crime
neutral_facts.reason: Largely accurate, but includes the Court's evaluative finding and the brother's testimony is presented as a fact of the case.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

physical_harm.reason: Seven ante mortem injuries; death from shock and haemorrhage.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 3 charged (s.302, s.392, s.397 with ss.34/395); 0 finally upheld
number_of_offences.quote: s.302 read with Section 34 and Section 392 read with Sections 395 and 397
number_of_offences.reason: The count is arguable; sections 34, 395, 397 are also charged sections, so '2 charged' undercounts.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Wrist watch and briefcase; Maruti car was missing and recovered from the co-accused
financial_property_loss.quote: the car of the deceased was also found to be missing
financial_property_loss.reason: Broadly right; the car was recovered from Sanjay, which the extraction notes.

motive.correct_value: alleged: robbery of the victim's belongings (briefcase, wrist watch)
motive.quote: murder of the husband of PW7 and taking away his belongings
motive.reason: The prosecution case alleges robbery as the motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted nothing as proving guilt; only possession of stolen goods can be inferred.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW7's identification of the watch does not inspire confidence (per the trial court, with which the Supreme Court concurred); PW15 is an interested witness, uncorroborated.
witness_credibility.quote: We have found no material on record which corroborated the statement of Raj Singh who is an interested witness
witness_credibility.reason: PW7 is the wife and the recovery witness; 'recovery witness' in the extraction conflates the roles.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Badal remained absent during trial and was declared a proclaimed offender; Sanjay's disclosure statements led to recovery of kirpan, clothes and car; the appellants' disclosure statements led to recovery of the items.
post_offence_conduct.quote: declared a proclaimed offender but he was arrested later
post_offence_conduct.reason: Mostly right, but the co-accused's disclosures are not mentioned.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse noted; the problems were evidential.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence: the co-accused's disclosure, recoveries of briefcase and watch, PW7's identification and PW15's testimony, treated by the High Court as a complete chain.
prosecution_argument.quote: The High Court relied firstly, on the statement of the wife of the deceased
prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment records the prosecution's case and the circumstances relied on even though no distinct submissions are set out.

defence_argument.reason: Defence at trial recorded; no Supreme Court submissions are given.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Mano v. State of Tamil Nadu (2001) 13 SCC 795 in the footnote (headnote gives 2007), otherwise as listed
precedent_relied_upon.reason: The year for Mano is inconsistent in the judgment; the extraction chose 2007 from the headnote.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Appellant in Crl. A. 1410/2010 to be set at liberty forthwith if not required in any other case; appellant in 703/2011 already on bail
other_sentence_order.quote: is directed to be set at liberty forthwith, if not required in any other case
other_sentence_order.reason: Accurate, though the High Court judgment was also set aside.
